cmd.description: The whole launch command is: uvx --from "easel-paint[mcp]" easel-mcp. Two things make it longer than usual. The MCP server is an optional extra, because nothing else in the engine imports mcp and a painter working from Python or the shell never needs its 28 dependencies; and the console script is easel-mcp, not easel-paint, because the package is a painting engine of which the server is one face. A client that cannot assemble this should run that command verbatim.
